name: @debugbundle/mcp

tools.name: get_improvement_review_plan
tools.description: Read the saved weekly review plan with evidence-linked failure, noise, flow or evidence checks and verification. Inspect current settings and linked bundles before an authorised change. Capture policy/rules, alert delivery, sensitivity and diagnostics have different effects. SDK-local settings are unobserved. Never suppress genuine failures or treat a quiet period as a verified fix. Reading never generates or changes anything.

tools.name: list_improvement_reviews
tools.description: List existing weekly project improvement reviews in an explicit workspace. Requires current access to each complete saved origin scope. Reads never generate, enqueue or call AI.

tools.name: get_improvement_review
tools.description: Read existing weekly review metadata, period and safe generation state. Missing evidence and correlations are not proven causes.

tools.name: get_improvement_review_bundle
tools.description: Read a saved versioned improvement review artifact containing bounded server facts, linked sources and optional validated investigation guidance. Pending work returns status without generating. Does not inspect a repository/UI or perform actions.

tools.name: get_improvement_review_settings
tools.description: Read the explicitly selected weekly review scope, evidence consent and schedule. No future projects are silently added.

tools.name: update_improvement_review_settings
tools.description: Replace weekly improvement review settings as current workspace Owner with expected_version, explicit project selection and source consent. Before enabling, obtain explicit chat confirmation of workspace, selected projects, evidence mode and recurring weekly provider use under the separate Team/Business allowance. Enabling schedules provider work only when qualified AI is enabled. Explain that consent/privacy narrowing or removing projects deletes affected derived content; paid/uncertain holds remain. Read settings back after saving. Existing customers default off. This does not send email or change ordinary opportunities.

tools.name: get_improvement_review_allowance
tools.description: Read the separate monthly improvement review allowance. Capacity and report generations do not multiply or share this pool. Does not reserve quota.

tools.name: list_report_deliveries
tools.description: Read safe per-recipient report email states under current whole-scope access. Accepted means provider acceptance, not inbox delivery. Uncertain sends are held and never automatically repeated. This read does not send mail, retry work, expose provider receipts or call AI.

tools.name: prepare_report_pdf
tools.description: Prepare or reuse a private PDF of the canonical report. Coalesces concurrent requests without another AI call or generation charge. Requires current read access to every frozen origin. Poll get_report_pdf; download links require authentication and expire with the report.

tools.name: get_report_pdf
tools.description: Read PDF preparation status and an authenticated download location when ready. Returns no PDF bytes or public bearer link. Current whole-scope access is checked again at download, including for retained archives after downgrade.

tools.name: get_report_allowance
tools.description: Read the shared monthly report pool, used/remaining generations and upcoming configured schedule demand through a currently readable whole-scope definition. Annual billing keeps monthly allowances. Forecast discloses partial schedule visibility. This does not reserve quota, change schedules or call AI.

tools.name: list_report_definitions
tools.description: List report definitions readable across every saved project/origin. Retained paused definitions remain visible after downgrade.

tools.name: get_report_definition
tools.description: Read a saved report definition, its version, explicit scope and pause/review state. Requires current access to the entire scope.

tools.name: create_report_definition
tools.description: Save a report definition with explicit projects and evidence consent. Before enabling, obtain explicit chat confirmation of workspace, selected projects, cadence/time, evidence mode, verified email recipients and recurring allowance/provider use. Solo includes monthly factual reports; Team weekly/monthly factual reports; Business daily/weekly/monthly Smart Reports with AI analysis and safe factual fallback. Only AI definitions may send redacted evidence to a configured model. Reuse the request UUID after a lost acknowledgement and read the saved definition back. Capacity does not multiply plan limits.

tools.name: update_report_definition
tools.description: Replace a report definition using expected_version and current administration of all selected projects. Confirm the proposed scope, cadence, evidence consent and AI/email changes in chat before saving, then read the saved definition back. Changes affect future unclaimed work and may alter scheduled AI/email delivery. Unchanged selections keep frozen origins; only the current Owner may explicitly clear a plan-loss review pause.

tools.name: delete_report_definition
tools.description: Delete a report definition and its retained report history with current whole-scope administration and expected saved version. Stops scheduled work and queued delivery. Disable the definition to retain its history. Existing weekly digests remain unchanged.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List retained report runs under current access to every frozen origin. Follow next_cursor even when an authorised page is empty.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read a report's status, period, scope and expiry. This returns metadata, never private model requests or provider receipts.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Queue a report for an explicit completed UTC period and expected definition version. Reuse the stable request UUID and identical command after a lost acknowledgement. Regeneration consumes another shared monthly generation. Solo and Team factual reports make no AI requests. Business Smart Reports may send bounded redacted evidence to the configured provider; email is false unless explicitly requested. Cannot choose models, budgets or authority.

tools.name: cancel_report
tools.description: Cancel queued or processing report work under current administration of every origin. Already paid or uncertain provider costs remain accounted for; cancellation does not recall delivered email.

tools.name: delete_report
tools.description: Delete a report and its private generated content under current whole-scope administration. Stops queued work and delivery; minimal financial receipts may remain. Does not recall delivered email.

tools.name: get_report_content
tools.description: Read the immutable canonical report facts, any available qualitative narrative and current retained-source availability. Requires current read access to every frozen origin, including after downgrade. Does not call AI or consume another generation.

tools.name: get_report_html
tools.description: Read the same private report as static escaped HTML, suitable for saving locally. No scripts, remote assets, public sharing URLs or new generation. Current whole-scope access and expiry still apply.
